todaysEvents.delta: Reuters reported Oct 1, citing Marisks, that three Liberian-flagged oil tankers were hit by unknown projectiles during Sep 29 Hormuz transits with AIS switched off.
Reuters reported Sep 30 that Iran received a US response through Qatari mediators. An official said the parties disagree on sequencing; no signed reopening agreement was reported.
Reuters Oct 1, citing four sources, reports Chinese refiners halted oil-product exports beyond Hong Kong and Macau. December Brent settled at $102.31 (+4.37%); Yahoo BZ=F is a separate observation.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Qatari mediation produces agreed sequencing and a monitored reopening. A US response has been received, but a signed agreement and durable shipping normalisation remain unverified.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.description: Selective Qatar-linked LNG passages and recovered oil exports coexist with tanker attacks and restricted Hormuz access. Current replacement supply, freight and cargo cost observations remain incomplete.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.description: Sequencing disagreements persist or attacks further disrupt Hormuz and alternative export routes. Marisks reported three tankers struck on Sep 29; insurance and replacement LNG costs remain unverified.
